deliveries_due_idx.name: deliveries_due_idx
deliveries_due_idx.where: status = 'scheduled' AND due_at IS NOT NULL

notifications_audience_check.name: notifications_audience_check
notifications_audience_check.value:
(audience_kind = 'recipients' AND recipient_ids IS NOT NULL AND topic_id IS NULL)
        OR (audience_kind = 'topic' AND recipient_ids IS NULL)
        OR (audience_kind = 'everyone' AND recipient_ids IS NULL AND topic_id IS NULL)

recipients_kind_check.name: recipients_kind_check
recipients_kind_check.value:
(kind = 'user' AND issuer IS NOT NULL AND subject IS NOT NULL AND sender_id IS NULL)
        OR (kind = 'address' AND sender_id IS NOT NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL AND address IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind = 'system' AND sender_id IS NOT NULL AND system_id IS NOT NULL)
